description: Loading.dev — Minimalist micro-motion loading indicators and SVG spinners

tech_stack.css_framework: Pure CSS Variables + SVG / Semantic HTML

components.name: Arc
components.description: Single open stroke rotating in a circle.
components.metaphor: Minimal open circular stroke sweeping 360 degrees.
components.when_to_use: Compact button submitting, inline text status, search input trailing icon
components.when_not_to_use: Large fullscreen splash screens where hairline stroke feels too thin

components.name: Ring
components.description: Delicate arc rotating in a faint circular track.
components.metaphor: Luminous halo orbiting a dim concentric ring.
components.when_to_use: Pull-to-refresh headers, modal dialog content loading, form submission

components.name: Comet
components.description: Full ring fading into a smooth luminous tail.
components.metaphor: Comet head with radiant fading conic-gradient streak.
components.when_to_use: AI prompt generation buffer, token streaming warmup, high-tech crypto verification

components.name: Dual
components.description: Two concentric arcs rotating in counter-opposing directions.
components.metaphor: Planetary counter-rotating gears in mechanical equilibrium.
components.when_to_use: Two-way data sync (cloud <-> local), bidirectional handshakes, compilation processes

components.name: Trace
components.description: Dash tracing the boundary outline of a rounded square.
components.metaphor: Laser beam inspecting the perimeter of a squircle card.
components.when_to_use: Card container loading, skeleton avatar placeholders, bounding box scanning
components.when_not_to_use: Circular badge contexts where rectangular geometry clashes

components.name: Snake
components.description: Elastic arc stretching and contracting as it revolves.
components.metaphor: Fluid chord dynamically extending and snapping back along a circle.
components.when_to_use: Network bandwidth buffering, video/audio segment preloading, elastic wait times

components.name: Radar
components.description: Radial gradient sweep with concentric distance rings.
components.metaphor: Active sonar/radar sweep scanning for targets in 360 degrees.
components.when_to_use: Device/bluetooth discovery, agent web exploration tool, security auditing

components.name: Clock
components.description: Single clock hand sweeping steadily around a subtle face.
components.metaphor: Precision chronograph sweeping time.
components.when_to_use: Scheduled cron jobs, backup progress, SLA countdowns, time-series aggregation

components.name: Compass
components.description: Four cardinal ticks rotating and snapping 90 degrees.
components.metaphor: Magnetic needle calibrating and locking onto headings.
components.when_to_use: Map orientation alignment, sensor calibration, directional positioning

components.name: Bouncing dots
components.description: Three staggered dots bouncing harmonically up and down.
components.metaphor: Conversational typing bubble activity.
components.when_to_use: Chat bubble typing indicator ('Agent is typing...'), comment drafting, live messaging
components.when_not_to_use: Vertical-height-constrained table rows where bounce clips cells

components.name: Circular dots
components.description: Eight dots arranged in a ring, the brightest stepping around.
components.metaphor: Rotary LED dial with sequential illumination.
components.when_to_use: Application initialization, dashboard widget initial load, firmware flashing

components.name: Linear dots
components.description: Three in-line dots lighting up sequentially from left to right without vertical displacement.
components.metaphor: Gentle pulsating ellipsis (...) in place.
components.when_to_use: Inline button text suffix (e.g., 'Saving...'), table cell updates, status bar footers

components.name: Eclipse
components.description: Two dots trading positions with 3D depth-scaling and opacity shift.
components.metaphor: Binary star system passing in front and behind each other.
components.when_to_use: Model comparison (A/B testing), token/asset balance transfers, dual-agent collaboration

components.name: Leap
components.description: Three dots in a line, the trailing dot hopping over its peers to the front.
components.metaphor: Leapfrog progression through a stage pipeline.
components.when_to_use: Job queue advancement, ingestion pipeline step transitions, background task workers

components.name: Slide
components.description: Three dots sequentially sliding into the vacant corner of a square.
components.metaphor: 15-puzzle sliding tiles rotating around a perimeter.
components.when_to_use: Layout rearrangement, card sorting/re-indexing, database partition re-balancing

components.name: Classic
components.description: Twelve radial bars with stepped decay in opacity.
components.metaphor: Apple iOS/macOS UIActivityIndicatorView radial wheel.
components.when_to_use: Standard system-level waiting state, iOS hybrid mobile web views, modal confirmation

components.name: Classic v2
components.description: Eight streamlined tick marks with two bright cursors stepping along the ring.
components.metaphor: Modernized high-contrast radial tick indicator.
components.when_to_use: Modern desktop web apps, top header navigation bars, developer dashboard status

components.name: Loading
components.description: The loading.dev signature mark, block ring with leading highlight.
components.metaphor: Chunky 8-bit digital pixel wheel.
components.when_to_use: Tech devtools, retro cyber interfaces, platform brand loading mark

components.name: Blocks
components.description: Nine blocks shrinking and growing in a sweep across a 3x3 grid.
components.metaphor: Cellular automaton or matrix spreadsheet calculation wave.
components.when_to_use: Spreadsheet math calculation, batch image processing, matrix data transformation

components.name: Gather
components.description: Four blocks pulling together, turning 90 degrees, and pushing apart.
components.metaphor: Mechanical docking, packaging, and module assembly.
components.when_to_use: Module bundling (Webpack/Vite), package resolution, dependency build stage

components.name: Swirl
components.description: A bright cell chasing its trail around a 3x3 square perimeter.
components.metaphor: Circuit loop cycling around a static central node.
components.when_to_use: Data ETL pipelines, cache preheating, cyclic checksum validation

components.name: Morph
components.description: A square rounding smoothly into a circle and back while rotating.
components.metaphor: Topological 2D shape interpolation.
components.when_to_use: File format conversion, view mode toggle (grid to list), vectorization rendering

components.name: Flip
components.description: A 3D square tumbling over on one axis, then the other.
components.metaphor: 3D tumbling cube face with perspective.
components.when_to_use: 3D model loading, flashcard generation, shader compilation
components.when_not_to_use: Flat minimalist monochrome interfaces where 3D perspective looks out of place

components.name: Pulse
components.description: A ring rippling outward from a solid central dot.
components.metaphor: Radio beacon ping or heartbeat expanding outward.
components.when_to_use: Live server status, WebSocket connection heartbeat, ambient sensor ping
components.when_not_to_use: Indeterminate lengthy calculations with no rhythmic frequency

components.name: Ripple
components.description: Three concentric rings spreading out continuously from the center.
components.metaphor: Water droplet ripples or sound wave acoustic propagation.
components.when_to_use: Voice assistant listening state ('Listening...'), audio recording, broadcast signal sending

components.name: Cascade
components.description: Three nested arcs fanning into a spiral and snapping back in line with elastic cubic-bezier.
components.metaphor: Multi-tiered centrifugal governor snapping back into alignment.
components.when_to_use: High-throughput asynchronous job orchestration, fan-out query execution

components.name: Wave
components.description: Five vertical bars rising and falling harmonically in a sine wave.
components.metaphor: Graphic equalizer or sound VU meter.
components.when_to_use: Voice speech synthesis (TTS) playback, audio stream buffering, music playback activity
components.when_not_to_use: Non-acoustic data requests (saving profile, updating email)

components.name: Atom
components.description: Three 3D orbital rings tumbling continuously inside an outer sphere.
components.metaphor: Rutherford atom model with quantum orbital rings in 3D perspective.
components.when_to_use: Deep neural reasoning, scientific simulations, complex quantum/AI computation

components.name: Orbit
components.description: A fading half-arc track revolving smoothly around a central satellite dot.
components.metaphor: Satellite orbiting a planet along an elliptical gravitational track.
components.when_to_use: Distributed server cluster synchronization, multi-region database replication
